summary: Iter 226 frontend verification (perf/storage). Lazy routes: 17 routes tested as admin (/app, approvals, employees, projects, quotations, inventory, scaffolding, store-inventory, admin, admin/users, admin/audit-logs, hr/leave, hr/payroll, safety, logistics, logistics/vehicles, services/requests) all render real content, route-loading spinner clears, zero ChunkLoadError / dynamic import / pageerror (only 2 pre-login 401s from auth probe). Admin console System Health card navigates to /app/admin/system-health. All 6 metric cards show values (MB, %, %, MB, ms, min up); history chart renders (recharts svg); Refresh, Trim memory (success toast) and Run housekeeping (success toast, Last housekeeping timestamp updated 3:58 PM -> 4:01 PM IST) work. slow_ms 1500->1400 saved, persisted after reload, restored to 1500 (verified). OneDrive: primary_reads checkbox present + checked by default; Document Storage tab (onedrive-tab-storage) renders audit card: 103 active docs, 55 pushed, 0 verified, 55 failed, 16 module rows; Refresh works; Verify pushed files -> 200 + toast 'Verified 0 · failed 0 · candidates 0'. 'Queue all historical files' NOT clicked. sales@erp.com on /app/admin/system-health gets clean 'Access Denied' route guard page (no API call, no crash). One real bug found: 30s auto-refresh wipes unsaved threshold form edits.

ui_bugs.issue: Unsaved edits are silently reset every 30 s. load() runs on a 30s setInterval and calls setSnap with a fresh settings object; ThresholdForm's useEffect(() => setF(settings), [settings]) then overwrites the form. Reproduced: typed 1234 in health-setting-slow_ms, waited 33 s, value reverted to 1500.

issues: Trim memory / Housekeeping success toasts show raw JSON (e.g. {"rss_before_mb":224.1,...}) truncated to 160 chars. Format them, e.g. 'Freed 1.8 MB'.
Subtitle says '30-day history' but the chart is titled 'Last 7 days' (days=7). Minor inconsistency.
If the first load fails, the page stays on 'Loading system health…' forever with an error toast every 30 s. No error state or retry.
Modules where every pushed file failed verification (e.g. quotations pushed 13 / failed 13) still show status 'verifying'. A 'failed' or 'needs attention' badge would be clearer.

action_items: SystemHealth.jsx: stop the 30 s poll from overwriting ThresholdForm edits. Options: only re-seed the form when not dirty, key the useEffect on a settings version or updated_at, or pass settings only on first load or after save.
Optional: show readable toasts for trim/housekeeping, an error/retry state when the first load fails, and a 'failed' status badge in the storage audit table.
critical_code_review_comments: SystemHealth.jsx line 34: useEffect(() => setF(settings), [settings]) together with setInterval(load, 30000) at line 98 causes the form-reset bug.
SystemHealth.jsx line 107: when snap is null after an error, the page renders loading forever.
seed_data_creation: None. slow_ms was changed to 1400 and restored to 1500 (verified).
